summary: Very steep residential kerb with houses 4-6 m away on the same side.
reasons: Dwellings 4 m and 6 m from kerb

best_section.where: Top end of the west kerb, above the houses, near the northern parked cars

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 6 m away at 16 m and 4 m at 27 m; apartments and houses all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street with cars parked on the west side; no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Quiet dead-end style residential street off the cross road.
drivers.convention: Residents park along the kerb; no signs mapped.

sun_shade: Mostly open; tree shade from the east at the lower end.
